captions.detailed: This is a 3D model of an external-routing mechanical dropper seatpost topped with a bicycle saddle. The assembly consists of a cylindrical outer black tube with a seat-tube binder ring at its base, an inner black post that telescopes vertically, and a mid-section cable routing port. At the top of the inner post is a metallic two-bolt saddle rail clamp plate that holds two parallel steel rails. A black, flat-nosed saddle shell body is attached to these rails, allowing for a tilt-adjust revolute pivot movement relative to the post.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of an external-routing dropper seatpost with a bicycle saddle. The model should feature a black outer tube clamped in a binder ring, a telescoping inner post on a prismatic joint, a side cable-routing port, and a two-bolt saddle rail clamp holding the steel rails of a black flat-nosed saddle on a tilt-adjustable revolute joint.
captions.factory: Construct the outer tube and inner telescoping post using concentric Cylinder primitives. Model the seat-tube binder ring, cable routing port, and cable anchor clamp using combined Box and Cylinder shapes offset from the main axis. Create the saddle clamp assembly with small Box and Cylinder elements representing the plates and bolts. Model the saddle rails using swept profiles or bent Cylinders, and construct the flat-nosed saddle shell from a lofted or extruded profile. Define a prismatic joint for the vertical telescoping inner post and a revolute joint for the saddle tilt adjustment.
